query:
SELECT u.id AS "id!"
        FROM users u
        WHERE u.id = ANY($2)
          AND (
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM course_enrollments e
                WHERE e.user_id = u.id AND e.course_id = $1
            )
            OR
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM courses c
                WHERE c.id = $1 AND c.teacher_id = u.id
            )
          )
